text: つくえの　うえに　あるのは　わしが　つくった　ポケモンずかん！

structure.jp: つくえの　うえに　あるのは
わしが　つくった　ポケモンずかん！

patterns.name: 〜のは
patterns.explanation: の after a verb stands for 'the thing' or 'the one', and は then sets it up as what the sentence is about. つくえのうえにあるのは = 'the thing that is on the desk is...'

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: わしが　つくった　ポケモンずかん
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. わしがつくったポケモンずかん = 'the Pokédex that I made'.
